outer_schemes.file_block5: five contiguous blocks of sorted unique fileNumber

inner_validation: leave one of the remaining outer file groups out in turn
response_learning: low-order surfaces fitted to quantile-cell median log energies; fileNumber is not a response feature
bootstrap: 1000 paired file-resampling replicates on frozen OOF predictions; the full method-selection and response-learning pipeline is not retrained
